implemented: Validates installed shader platform/frequency, actual draw-binding layout and RHI shader compiled output hash, including configurations without editor-only FShader output hashes.

Matches explicit input data by original D3D source register, then binds using the converted ParameterMap remapped uniform index. Every prepared contract and shader uniform slot must be covered exactly once.
Creates original-layout RHI buffers from current CPU parameter bytes and explicit member overrides, validates prepared target layouts, and uses an explicit actual Material expression buffer.
Completes fallible checks and buffer creation before writing draw bindings. Returns strong RHI references which callers must retain through draw-command release.

engine_contracts.binding: Renderer/Public/MeshDrawShaderBindings.h: FMeshDrawSingleShaderBindings::Add stores raw RHI uniform pointers using FShaderUniformBufferParameter::GetBaseIndex.
engine_contracts.output_identity: RenderCore/Private/ShaderResource.cpp: FShaderMapResource_InlineCode::CreateRHIShader sets FRHIShader hash from the compiled code entry. FShader::GetHash is a source hash and GetOutputHash is editor-only.

verification: Bounded source/API review and diff checks only; no build or runtime verification.
remaining: No pass/provider calls this bridge yet.
Caller must supply correct current producer bytes, complete missing original member values and resource ownership; no aliases or semantic defaults are inferred.
Loose parameters and other mesh resources remain the pass caller's responsibility.
RHI references returned by this bridge must outlive all raw mesh draw bindings using them.
